Elevated 1-hour GCT with all normal 3-hour GTT values
cohort: 5,983 women with singleton pregnancies undergoing universal GDM screening between 24 and 28 weeks gestation
finding: Women with elevated 1-hour GCT results, even without a GDM diagnosis, had increased risks of macrosomia, PIH, indicated-preterm birth, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that women with insulin resistance, even without gestational diabetes, had increased risks of cesarean section.
